entries.t: 尽管车身更大、更重，Rivian R2 的效率仍可与 Tesla Model Y 相媲美
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/锂电池
entries.as: Rivian R2 Performance的EPA评级数据已公布。尽管该车比特斯拉Model Y更重（重约800磅）且外形更方正，但其综合效率达到105 MPGe，每100英里能耗32千瓦时，与Model Y Performance完全相同。同时，Rivian R2在续航方面超越Model Y，配备21英寸车轮时总续航里程达到330英里。
kp: 能效评级[Rivian R2 Performance EPA综合]: 105 MPGe
能耗水平[Rivian R2 Performance]: 32 kWh/100英里
续航里程[Rivian R2 Performance]: 330英里
续航里程[Tesla Model Y Performance]: 306英里
重量差[Rivian R2对比Model Y]: Rivian重近800磅
entries.b:
Fred Lambert
| May 29 2026 - 3:22 am PT
The Rivian R2 Performance’s final EPA ratings are now published, and the numbers confirm something impressive: the R2 Performance matches the Tesla Model Y Performance on efficiency at 105 MPGe combined and 32 kWh per 100 miles — while actually beating it on range with 330 miles versus 306.
What makes this particularly noteworthy is the R2’s form factor. The Rivian is a boxier, taller, more utilitarian SUV that weighs nearly 800 lbs more than the Model Y, yet it achieves identical efficiency.
The fueleconomy.gov data breaks down as follows for the R2 Performance with 21-inch wheels and all-season tires: 105 MPGe combined (114 city, 96 highway) with an energy consumption rate of 32 kWh per 100 miles and 330 miles of total range.
With the optional 20-inch all-terrain tires, efficiency drops to 99 MPGe combined (109 city, 89 highway) and 34 kWh per 100 miles, with range falling to 307 miles. That’s a meaningful penalty for the knobby tires, but still competitive.
It goes to show just how much of a difference tires have on efficiency.
For comparison, the 2026 Tesla Model Y Performance achieves 105 MPGe combined (111 city, 100 highway), 32 kWh per 100 miles, and 306 miles of range.
So on the standard 21-inch all-season setup, the R2 Performance and Model Y Performance are virtually identical on efficiency — and the R2 actually ekes out 24 more miles of range thanks to its slightly larger 86.8 kWh battery versus the Model Y’s 84 kWh pack.
The efficiency match becomes even more remarkable when you consider the physical differences between these two vehicles.
The R2 Performance tips the scales at approximately 5,250 lbs —
nearly 800 lbs heavier than the Model Y
. The Rivian is also noticeably taller with more ground clearance, has a boxier profile with a more upright windshield, and generally looks like the more traditional SUV of the pair. All of those characteristics typically kill aerodynamic efficiency.
Tesla has long been considered the benchmark for EV efficiency, and the Model Y’s sleek crossover shape is a big part of that. For Rivian to match it with a vehicle that prioritizes off-road capability and interior space is a significant engineering achievement.
Rivian’s new R2 platform benefits from
dramatic cost and weight reductions
compared to the R1, including die casting, a new drive unit, and simplified suspension. The R2 is roughly 1,300 lbs lighter than the R1S, and clearly, Rivian put that weight savings to good use.
The R2 Performance
starts at $57,990
with the Launch Package, which bundles Autonomy+, the Tow Package, and a Launch key fob. The Tesla Model Y Performance starts at $57,490. Pricing is essentially a wash between the two performance trims.
first R2 deliveries launching June 9
, consumers will soon be cross-shopping these two vehicles in earnest. The R2 offers more interior space and a more rugged design, while the Model Y has Tesla’s Supercharger network advantage and a more established service infrastructure.
Although the Supercharger advantage is only a cost basis right now since Rivian owners have access to the network.
The Rivian R2 matching the Tesla Model Y Performance on efficiency is one of the most impressive data points we’ve seen from a Tesla competitor. Efficiency has always been one of Tesla’s main advantages — the company’s vehicles consistently achieve better energy consumption than rivals, thanks to years of optimization on motors, inverters, heat management, and aerodynamics.
This is one of the main reasons Tesla has also been one of the few automakers capable of delivering EVs profitably at scale since it needs fewer battery cells per car to achieve range parity.
For Rivian to close that gap entirely with a vehicle that clearly prioritizes a more traditional SUV form factor is noteworthy. The R2 doesn’t look like a vehicle designed around a wind tunnel, it looks like a vehicle designed for adventure, with the efficiency to match the best in the business anyway.
We should note that real-world efficiency often differs from EPA ratings, and we’ll have to wait for independent testing to see how these numbers translate to actual driving.
It’s worth noting that the Model Y edges the R2 on highway driving, which is unsurprising since at higher speeds, drag becomes more important.
But on paper, the R2 Performance is positioning itself as the most compelling alternative to the Model Y Performance we’ve seen — matching it on efficiency and price while offering a more spacious, rugged package.
The bigger question is whether Rivian can
ramp production fast enough
to capitalize. Analysts estimate around 22,000-23,000 R2 units this year, a fraction of Model Y volume. But if the product is this competitive on paper, demand won’t be a problem.

entries.t: BYD Blade Battery Pack Teardown Shows Innovation
entries.c: 零碳产业/能量循环/能量存储/电化学储能/二次电池/锂电池
entries.as: 分析师拆解比亚迪第二代刀片电池组发现多项技术创新：比亚迪将动态制动单元（DBU）与电池管理系统（BMS）集成至单一模块以节约成本；采用制冷剂冷却技术取代循环水泵，提升了散热效率并降低成本；电池包大量使用环氧树脂灌封工艺，极大增加了拆卸难度，但为电池组件提供了极其坚固的物理保护。
kp: 模块集成[比亚迪电池包]: DBU与BMS集成为单一模块以节约成本
热管理方案[比亚迪电池包]: 采用制冷剂冷却，取消循环泵以降低成本并提高效率

entries.b:
Analyst Cai Shendao's teardown reveals BYD integrated the DBU and BMS into one module, uses refrigerant cooling, and epoxy potting.
May 28, 2026
BYD's EV platform, showing the battery pack in the floor.
The battery pack integrates dynamic braking and management systems into a single cost-saving module.
Refrigerant-based cooling eliminates the circulation pump, reducing costs and improving efficiency.
Extensive epoxy potting makes disassembly extremely difficult but provides robust protection.
Battery analyst Cai Shendao hosts
EV teardowns on Weibo.com
much in the manner of
Munro Live’s YouTube channel
, and the Chinese team has had a look inside the battery pack of a BYD EV that uses the company’s second-generation blade battery cells.
Shendao’s team had disassembled more than 20 battery packs previously, so there was plenty of familiar technology inside the BYD pack, but also some new features that caught his eye.
The first thing that Shendao noticed was BYD’s slick integration of the dynamic braking unit (DBU) and the battery management system (BMS) into a single module in the battery. “I remember last year at an exhibition, I visited BYD's booth and saw their integrated DBU and BMS design - it was excellent,” he recalled. “Among all the vehicle models we've seen, this is the best design in this aspect.”
BYD’s battery pack cooling plate design also showed innovation, according to Shendao. “This cooling plate actually works like an air conditioner - it uses refrigerant that cycles through gasification and liquefaction to remove heat. Refrigerant has a characteristic: its cooling effect is very good, as you can see with air conditioners.”
However, that doesn’t automatically make refrigerant the best solution for battery cooling. “Refrigerant also has disadvantages - its specific heat capacity is small, and its density is lower than liquids, so its heat-carrying capacity is weaker,” Shendao pointed out. “With the same circulation cycle, after removing heat its temperature rise will be significant because of its low density.”
Battery analyst Cai Shendao. CAI SHENDAO
The main advantage of refrigerant cooling of batteries is its efficiency, due to the system’s lack of a pump. “Liquid cooling requires air circulation to dissipate heat through a circulation pump,” he said. “Direct cooling uses an air conditioning compressor, so it eliminates this pump, reducing costs and increasing efficiency by eliminating one heat transfer step.”
This solution saves cost because, while there are higher design costs for a refrigerant-based system, manufacturing costs are lower, according to Shenbao. This might be unsuitable for high-performance applications, because the low specific heat capacity of refrigerant can permit development of heat accumulation in some areas of the battery pack, he warned. BYD has applied measures to reduce this concern. “BYD has cleverly addressed these deficiencies,” he observed. “Through the flow channel design, going back and forth, they've avoided some of these issues through the channel design.”
BYD’s battery pack is divided into three sections by a pair of transverse beams. Shenbao reports that there are two battery modules in each section, with 29 cells in each module in the forward two sections, while the modules in the aft section contain 27 cells each. The total number of cells is 170 in the pack.
The modules are potted in epoxy adhesive, making removal very challenging for the team. “This adhesive is extremely hard,” he noted. “We chiseled a hole in it - we chiseled very deep, and there was still adhesive inside, very deep and very solid.” It encases the battery's positive and negative terminals, connection wires, connection plates, temperature sensors, copper plates, and some fuse wires completely.
Shendao gives a shout-out to Munro Live during battery pack disassembly. CAI SHENDAO
The pack’s extensive use of epoxy was new to Shenbao. “We've disassembled more than 20 various battery packs before, and this is the first time we've encountered such a fully adhesive-sealed battery pack,” he said. “This is also the second time we've had to saw through the frame to disassemble the battery. But this battery pack exceeded our expectations.”
The team froze the battery for 40 hours before disassembly in a bid to make the epoxy more brittle so that it could be chiseled off more easily. “Even so, we still encountered huge problems with disassembly, because our disassembly goal is ultimately to extract various components for everyone to study. But with this one, other components couldn't be preserved. In the end, we could only sacrifice other components and preserve only the cells.”
The BYD battery pack has a robust protective plate on its bottom side to prevent intrusion. While the team anticipated a three-layer sandwich structure with a steel layer between two fiber layers, that wasn’t what they found.
This BYD pack’s protective plate is a two-layer design combining a fiber layer with what Shenbao describes as a “transparent milky white material” that could be plexiglass. “This bottom protective plate has excellent toughness and rigidity,” he said. “We hit it with a hammer and found its stiffness and hardness to be very good. This is the strongest bottom protective plate we've seen among all battery packs.”
The team finished the job by putting the pack on a scale and found that it weighs 1,258 lbs. (572 kilograms), making it apparently lighter than most.

entries.t: 大型语言模型在已发表的学术文章中的传播
entries.a: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
entries.c: AI与智能科技/AI软件层/底座大模型/文本模型
entries.as: 通过分析四大出版商2020至2025年间发表的730万篇期刊论文全文，研究追踪了大型语言模型(LLM)在学术界的传播。通过建立包含228个词频在2022年后激增的焦点词汇库进行评分，结果发现受LLM影响的论文比例从2023年的12%飙升至2025年的57%。受影响文本呈现出从细微语言变化到显著生成特征的异质性。
kp: 分析样本量[2020-2025年学术文章]: 730万篇期刊文章全文
特征词数量[LLM关联语言轨迹]: 228个焦点词汇
高频增长时间节点[LLM特征词汇使用]: 2022年后
entries.b: Large language models (LLMs) are rapidly changing academic research, raising questions of who is adopting these tools and under what conditions. This article analyzes full texts of 7.3 million journal articles published from 2020–2025 by four major publishers (Elsevier, Frontiers, MDPI, and PLoS) to track the prevalence of LLM-associated language and identify social and institutional correlates of adoption. A corpus of 228 focal words exhibiting sharp post-2022 frequency increases consistent with LLM output was developed; articles were scored on their rate of focal word usage. By 2025, an estimated 57% of published articles exhibited evidence of LLM influence, up from 12% in 2023. Among articles exhibiting LLM-influenced text, there is substantial heterogeneity, ranging from subtle linguistic influence to articles mostly or entirely LLM-generated. Difference-in-differences models reveal that LLM-associated language varies markedly across regions, institutional ranks, publishers, disciplines, and journal tiers. Economic development and proximity to English as a primary language are key predictors of regional variation. Lower-ranked institutions exhibit higher rates than elite universities, young for-profit publishers show elevated rates vis-à-vis competitors, and academic fields differ widely in adoption. LLM adoption in academic writing is pervasive but socially stratified. As models grow more powerful and their use becomes further entrenched in academic research, understanding social dynamics of adoption will be essential for governing the evolving relationship between AI and academic knowledge production.

entries.t: 使用肾脏可清除的金纳米簇进行保留对比 CT 进行肾功能障碍的早期空间测绘
entries.a: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 研究提出一种节省造影剂的CT方法，利用肾可清除的谷胱甘肽包覆金纳米簇在肾脏区室水平映射功能障碍。这种纳米簇具有2.8纳米的超小流体力学尺寸和强X射线衰减能力，能快速被肾脏清除并提供强效的CT对比度。在三种具有不同机制的急性肾损伤小鼠模型中，低剂量的该纳米簇在临床生物标志物发生变化之前，就产生了特定机制的成像特征和不同的时间衰减行为。
kp: 流体动力学尺寸[可肾清除金纳米簇]: 2.8纳米
纳米簇材料[保留对比CT空间测绘]: 谷胱甘肽修饰的金纳米簇(GSH-Au NCs)
造影机制[肾功能障碍早期检测]: 节省造影剂的计算机断层扫描(CT)
entries.b: Early, noninvasive, and spatially resolved assessment of renal dysfunction is essential for theranostics of kidney diseases, yet clinical biomarkers are criticized for averaging whole-kidney function and missing focal or unilateral injury. Here, we present a contrast-sparing computed tomography (CT) approach that maps renal dysfunction at the compartment level using renal-clearable glutathione-gold nanoclusters (GSH-Au NCs). The merits of ultrasmall hydrodynamic size (2.8 nanometers) and high x-ray attenuation ability enable GSH-Au NCs with fast renal clearance and robust intrarenal CT contrast. In three mechanistically distinct mouse models of acute kidney injury, low-dose GSH-Au NCs produced mechanism-specific imaging signatures and distinct time-attenuation behaviors, even before biomarkers changed. Notably, at an ultralow dose (32.5 milligrams of Au per kilogram), early bilateral cisplatin injury can be easily detected with an obvious bright band at the outer medulla area on CT, consistent with tubular injury and a cast/debris-mediated mechanism. This work establishes a dose-efficient CT workflow for early, noninvasive, spatial mapping of renal dysfunction, supporting diagnosis, classification, and monitoring of kidney disease.

entries.t: 以甲磺酸为主的海洋对流层上层快速粒子形成
entries.a: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences: Keyword search for query
entries.c: 通用技术/检测和表征/先进科学仪器
entries.as: 研究指出，海洋对流层上层的新粒子形成(NPF)维持着全球最大的气溶胶库之一。长期被仅视为边界层前体的甲磺酸(MSA)，实际上在各大海洋的上对流层NPF过程中占据主导地位。量子化学和团簇动力学模拟表明，MSA能将硫酸-氨的成核速率提高1到3个数量级，对气候预测中的气溶胶机制认知具有重大意义。
kp: 主导前体物质[海洋对流层上层快速粒子形成]: 甲磺酸(MSA)
关键作用[全球最大气溶胶储库]: 维持对流层下层云凝结核(CC)种子
entries.b:
New particle formation (NPF) in the marine upper troposphere sustains one of the largest global aerosol reservoirs that seeds cloud condensation nuclei in the lower troposphere, with far-reaching implications for Earth’s radiative balance and climate. However, the underlying NPF mechanisms remain elusive, constituting a major uncertainty in climate projections. Here, we show that methanesulfonic acid (MSA), long considered only as a key boundary-layer precursor, dominates upper-tropospheric NPF across major oceans. Quantum-chemical and cluster dynamics simulations reveal that MSA enhances sulfuric acid (H
                    2
                    SO
                    4
                    )–ammonia (NH
                    3
                    ) nucleation rates by 1 to 3 orders of magnitude, far surpassing the well-established nitric acid (HNO
                    3
                    )–H
                    2
                    SO
                    4
                    –NH
                    3
                    mechanism, owing to stronger intracluster hydrogen bonds and low temperatures that stabilize clusters and render nucleation nearly barrierless. Further global three-dimensional modeling constrained by field measurements confirms that the proposed H
                    2
                    SO
                    4
                    –MSA–NH
                    3
                    nucleation pathway dominates the upper-tropospheric NPF over the Pacific, Atlantic, and Indian Oceans. Notably, this pathway contributes ~40% of global nucleation-induced Aitken- and accumulation-mode aerosols at 0.5 to 4 km altitudes, where most cloud water resides, and yields a net top-of-atmosphere radiation forcing of −1.75 W m
                    −2
                    (~68% of the nucleation-induced response). This study offers a detailed mechanistic insight into marine upper-tropospheric NPF and improves representation of aerosol–cloud interactions, thereby reducing uncertainties in global climate projections.

entries.t: 原子级精确的 Cu4Pt2(CeqCCyOH)8 催化剂中具有三模块协同性的甲苯氧化
entries.as: 碳氢化合物中C(sp3)-H键的断裂与重组是催化领域的重大挑战。研究开发了一种原子级精确的Cu4Pt2(C≡CCyOH)8团簇作为电催化剂，用于甲苯氧化。该催化剂对苯甲醛表现出绝对的选择性，法拉第效率超过99%。其卓越性能源于三个功能模块的协同作用：配体捕获并向Cu位点释放水，水在Cu位点被激活生成OH自由基；Pt位点负责提取甲苯的氢原子；随后OH自由基完成最终的氧化偶联反应。
kp: 选择性[甲苯氧化电催化]: 专一生成苯甲醛
法拉第效率[原子级精确Cu4Pt2(C≡CCyOH)8簇催化剂]: >99%
功能机制[Cu4Pt2(C≡CCyOH)8簇]: 集成三个功能模块的系统性协同作用
entries.b: The dismantling and reassembly of C(sp3)-H bonds in hydrocarbons over both heterogeneous and homogeneous catalysts remain a fundamental challenge. Here we report the toluene oxidation using an atomically precise Cu4Pt2(C≡CCyOH)8 cluster (HC≡CCyOH = 1-ethynyl-1-cyclohexanol) as the electrocatalyst with an exclusive selectivity for benzaldehyde accompanied by >99% Faradaic efficiency. Results reveal the systematic cooperativity of three functional modules combined into one cluster catalyst for six temporally subsequent events: the hydroxyl ligand of this cluster can capture water and then release it to the Cu sites, and water is sequentially activated on the Cu sites to form OH radicals; Pt sites engage in the abstraction of a hydrogen atom from the methyl group of toluene; the OH radicals then flip over to the Pt sties and react with dehydro-toluene to produce benzaldehyde, which is finally disentangled from the active sites with the help of the ligand. Meanwhile, the cluster is also used to catalyze the hydrogen evolution reaction at the cathode and exhibits much higher activity for hydrogen production than a typical Pt/C catalyst. Our study presents a molecular approach for designing highly active and selective catalysts for efficient inert molecule-involved reactions.
